items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Cootie Williams was there with eight pieces... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah-yeah-yeah.

ctx.x: No, I don't think they... They continued it under another name. And then the Savoy, of course, was open for... This was maybe the last stage of the Savoy, in the Fifties, wasn't it?
Let me see. Yes, it is, because... The last time I was there, Cootie Williams was there with eight pieces and an organ player. You know, it was all...
